coverage_exempt.reason: Source-reviewed allocation-null arm: clears ESI then unconditionally calls owned 0x4ecb00 with ECX=0; its store at 0x4ecb08 dereferences 0x24. No returning execution exists with the unmapped null page. The returning comparison domain excludes this intrinsic fault, not any successful factory kind.

Source-reviewed count=-1 wrap arm: new count becomes zero, any old list is freed, manager list/count/capacity become zero, then 0x4ec282 reloads the null list and 0x4ec289 writes at list + (-1)*4 = 0xfffffffc. This malformed-list path cannot return in the bounded valid-object domain.

Source-reviewed kind-3 null-init arm: original default constructor 0x4ecc30 clears init+0x10 and init+0x14; initializer 0x4ecd00 then takes the absent-table branch and at 0x4ecd3b reads palette+0xc through init+0x10=0. It faults before returning to 0x4ec563, so the entire default-init branch has no returning execution. Supplied kind-3 init and every factory kind remain covered.
